purpose: Skill-level high-granularity interpretation templates distilled from local references and user-supplied article clues. These templates are guarded by source levels, cross-checks, confidence ceilings and forbidden claims.
global_rules: Do not turn online article claims into hard predictions without D1/Varga/Dasha/Transit cross-checks.
Use these templates after the strict workflow router has established the relevant promise and timing layer.
Keep personal user data out of persistent skill files and public repositories.
Treat JHora/PyJHora as external oracle sources only; do not copy incompatible licensed implementations.

yogi_asc_tight_orb_wealth.title: Yogi Point / Ascendant Degree / Tight Orb Wealth Activation
required_cross_checks: D1 wealth promise: 2H/11H/5H/9H and their lords
Dhana/Lakshmi Yoga and Jupiter/Venus support
D2, D9 and D10 confirmation when wealth is career-linked
Dasha and transit activation of Yogi planet, Duplicate Yogi or wealth lords
Avayogi damage check before upgrading confidence
yogi_asc_tight_orb_wealth.confidence_ceiling: B unless wealth promise, varga support and timing activation all agree; C when only Yogi/tight-orb signal exists.
forbidden_claims: Yogi Point conjunct Lagna guarantees wealth
A tight orb alone proves millionaire status
Gemstone/remedy guarantees money
safe_output_patterns: Yogi Point can refine the prosperity activation channel after the main wealth promise is established.
A <1° contact is a sensitivity amplifier, not an independent wealth promise.
Avayogi contacts should be framed as leakage or friction to manage, not fatalism.

ashwini_talent_profile.title: Ashwini / Ketu Nakshatra Talent And Action Style
required_cross_checks: Placement of Moon, Lagna, Sun, AK, AmK, 10L or 1L in Ashwini/Magha/Mula
Ketu condition, dispositor and Dasha activation
Mars condition because Ashwini is in Aries
D9, D10 and D24 support for talent-to-career conversion
Panchanga context for electional use
ashwini_talent_profile.confidence_ceiling: B for career style when D10/Dasha support exists; C for personality color only.
forbidden_claims: Ashwini alone makes someone a doctor
Ashwini guarantees wealth or spiritual status
Ketu nakshatra days are always bad
safe_output_patterns: Ashwini favors quick response, repair, healing, mobility and pioneer behavior when the chart supports it.
Ketu nakshatra days are task-sensitive: useful for cutting, repair and root-work; cautious for pure stability commitments.
Abhijit is mainly an electional support window, not a standalone natal destiny marker.

rtn_high_order_d9.title: Rashi Tulya Navamsa And High-Order D9 Anomaly Reading
required_cross_checks: Standard D1 and D9 promise first
Vargottama and Pushkara check before RTN weighting
D9 7L, Venus/Jupiter, DK and D9 Lagna condition
Mapped D1 house condition and event-relevant Varga
Dasha/transit activation before event claims
rtn_high_order_d9.confidence_ceiling: B for motive/inner-pattern interpretation; C for timing unless Dasha and event Varga agree.
forbidden_claims: RTN alone proves divorce, death or disaster
Yama/Preta/Pisacha labels can be used as deterministic outcomes
D9 anomaly overrides D1 promise
safe_output_patterns: RTN explains how Navamsa motives project into D1 life fields.
High-order D9 anomalies are warnings that require timing confirmation.
Use RTN as a depth layer after ordinary D1/D9 analysis, not as the first judgment.

bhrigu_pada_all_event.title: Bhrigu Pada / Arudha Pada All-Event Progression Template
required_cross_checks: D1 promise for the event domain
Select correct Pada: A2/A5/A7/A8/A10/A11/UL
Pada lord condition and relevant Varga
Vimshottari/Chara/transit convergence
Past-event verification before personal rule upgrade
bhrigu_pada_all_event.confidence_ceiling: B as auxiliary event confirmation; C if used without Dasha/transit convergence.
forbidden_claims: Bhrigu Pada Dasha alone proves an event
A single progression proves exact date
Marriage-counting rules can be generalized to all charts without verification
safe_output_patterns: Use the relevant Arudha Pada to identify how an event becomes visible in the world.
Treat Bhrigu Pada as a confirmation/progression layer, not a standalone prediction engine.
Upgrade only after Dasha, transit and event Varga agree.

tithi_lord_relationship.title: Tithi Lord Relationship And Emotional Rhythm Template
required_cross_checks: D1/D9 relationship promise
Moon, Venus/Jupiter and 7L condition
Dasha activation of Tithi lord or relationship significators
Transit Moon/Jupiter/Saturn trigger only inside supported windows
tithi_lord_relationship.confidence_ceiling: C for standalone relationship judgment; B only when D1/D9/Dasha agree.
forbidden_claims: Tithi Lord alone decides marriage fate
One lunar-day trait proves compatibility
safe_output_patterns: Tithi Lord can describe emotional rhythm and response style after relationship promise is checked.
Use it to refine timing texture, not to replace 7H/D9/Dasha.

pancha_pakshi_swara_boundary.title: Pancha Pakshi / Swara Boundary Template
required_cross_checks: Primary Muhurta factors: Tithi, Vara, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana
Moon strength and Tarabala/Chandrabala when available
Natal Dasha/transit relevance for personal actions
Avoid replacing core Muhurta with Pakshi/Swara alone
pancha_pakshi_swara_boundary.confidence_ceiling: C as auxiliary electional texture; B only with full Muhurta support.
forbidden_claims: Pakshi/Swara alone makes a time auspicious
One folk-timing layer overrides bad Moon or Dasha
safe_output_patterns: Use Pakshi/Swara as a final action-timing refinement after ordinary Muhurta checks.
Frame weak Pakshi/Swara periods as caution or lower efficiency, not unavoidable failure.

lakshmi_dhana_activation_chain.title: Lakshmi Yoga / Dhana Yoga / Wealth Activation Chain
required_cross_checks: D1 wealth promise through 2H, 11H, 5H, 9H, 10H and their lords
Lakshmi Yoga / Dhana Yoga / Raja Yoga overlap and benefic support
D2, D9 and D10 confirmation for asset, merit and career monetization
Shadbala, Ashtakavarga and dignity support before upgrading confidence
Dasha, transit and annual activation before claiming a wealth window
lakshmi_dhana_activation_chain.confidence_ceiling: B unless promise, divisional support and timing all agree; C when only one wealth yoga or article-style signal is present.
forbidden_claims: Lakshmi Yoga alone guarantees great wealth
Dhana Yoga alone proves millionaire status
A single wealth yoga overrides weak houses, weak D2 or hostile Dasha
safe_output_patterns: Treat Lakshmi and Dhana Yogas as wealth potential that still needs divisional support and timing activation.
Explain whether wealth comes through career, luck, family, assets or patronage rather than only saying rich/not rich.
If Avayogi, weak D2 or hostile Dasha interferes, frame the result as delayed or effort-heavy wealth rather than denial or guarantee.

darakaraka_ul_spouse_depth.title: Darakaraka / Upapada / D9 Spouse Depth Template
required_cross_checks: D1 seventh house, seventh lord and classical spouse significators first
D9 seventh house, D9 lagna, Venus/Jupiter and DK condition
UL sign, UL lord and second-from-UL support
Declare DK system ambiguity when 7-karaka and 8-karaka methods disagree
Dasha, transit and relationship timing support before event or marriage timing claims
darakaraka_ul_spouse_depth.confidence_ceiling: B for spouse profile when D1, D9, DK and UL converge; C when only one Jaimini indicator is active or DK method is disputed.
forbidden_claims: DK alone proves the spouse type
UL alone guarantees marriage outcome
A single DK or UL signal alone predicts divorce, widowhood or exact marriage fate
safe_output_patterns: Use DK to describe the spouse archetype, UL to describe the visible marriage narrative, and D9 to describe the lived marriage quality.
If DK methods disagree, weaken DK and let D1 seventh house plus Venus/Jupiter lead the interpretation.
Upgrade only when D1 promise, D9 support, UL condition and timing all point in the same direction.
